traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Gunneraceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire, serrate or dentate; veins palmate; blades ovate or obovate; stipules usually present, rarely absent; leaf rosettes basal; plants monoecious, dioecious or polygamous; ovary inferior; floral cup absent; stems herbaceous; flowers in panicles, in racemes or in spikes; perianth usually sepals and petals, sometimes tepals; fruit drupe or nut; parts of each whorl 2; stamens 1 to 2; carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 296, 297, family Gunneraceae: phyllotaxis pattern spiral; read as "spiral".

traits.life_span.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 296, 297, family Gunneraceae: life span perennial (annual in G. herteri), usually; read as {"perennial": "usually"}.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Added kinds only; the usual kind's source is the family's `traits` note. The books add orbicular (sometimes): Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 296, 297: orbicular to ovate.
